about: Brain age (App. C.3): ridge regression of age on each subject's mean embedding (each recording's for ISRUC and WSC); alpha chosen by nested 4-fold CV on train+val, then refit there and scored by MAE on the test fold.
_doc: Brain age (Appendix C.3): ridge regression of chronological age on each unit's mean embedding (a subject, or a recording where cohort_protocols says so). alpha is chosen by nested CV -- 4 inner folds stratified on age bins [0,35,50,65,80,200] over the merged train+val units, seed 43, StandardScaler -- from the grid below, then refit on train+val and scored on the test fold; metrics.best_test (and metrics.ridge_subject_nested_cv) is that score, selected on MAE. The validation-split ridge and the epoch-level ridge also run, as secondary blocks. cohort_protocols sets each cohort's split: it re-splits the cohort's own sleep-staging embeddings at probe time, so none of it enters the embedding cache key. A cohort not listed (cfs, mros) keeps its reader's own age-stratified folds.

sleep_edf_expanded._doc: Sleep Cassette only: 78 subjects, 153 nights; the 22 telemetry subjects are excluded before folding (cv_filter_scope pool), and the two nights of a subject are pooled into one vector.

isruc._doc: One unit per recording (124: subgroup II has two per subject; I_086 and I_095 have no age), folded at subject level so a subject's recordings stay together.

physionet2026._doc: Brain-age gap: 100 healthy + 100 impaired subjects, age-matched, are held out of every fold; folds are drawn over the rest and the ridge is trained on the healthy subjects only (cv_filter on the splits).

wsc._doc: One unit per visit recording, folded at subject level (a subject's visits stay together; each visit keeps its own age).
